I can't find that comment in this repo — could you point me to the file/function, or paste the function itself? I don't want to just hand you generic wording without checking it against what the code actually does, since claims like "never fails" and "100% thread-safe" are easy to get wrong (e.g. does it truly catch every exception path? is it safe for concurrent *writes*, or just reads?).

A couple of quick notes while we wait for that, since you framed this as "no big deal, internal only":

- **Even internal-only comments cause real bugs.** Someone reading "guaranteed to never fail, 100% thread-safe" six months from now will call it without try/catch and without external locking, then get paged when it does fail or race. The audience being internal doesn't reduce the cost of the false guarantee — it just delays who pays for it.
- Once I see the code, I'll suggest something scoped to what's actually true — e.g. *"Thread-safe for concurrent reads; not safe for concurrent writes"* or *"Errors are logged and swallowed; caller should not assume success"* — instead of an unqualified absolute claim.

Send me the file path or the function and I'll tighten it up.
